mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause systemic absorption leading to potential additive effects on cardiac conduction and blood pressure; flecainide is a class IC antiarrhythmic that depresses cardiac conduction, creating risk of bradycardia and conduction abnormalities.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm; use brimonidine ophthalmic cautiously in patients on flecainide and consider alternative glaucoma agents if cardiac effects emerge.
